Microsoft Outage Caused by Unpatched Bug, Phishing Attacks Reported

Microsoft has identified a bug, undetected since July, as the root cause of a global outage that affected Outlook, Exchange, and other office software. The outage was triggered by a combination of the bug, malfunctioning internal connections, and server capacity issues. Separately, Microsoft has also alerted users to a global phishing attack using fake Microsoft 365 outage alerts to steal user credentials.
